items: 【98FT High Visibility Green Cross Line Laser】 This high-precision laser level uses advanced Diode Technology and emits a bright green beam with 110° horizontal and vertical lines. Delivers up to 100ft visibility with ±1/9 inch accuracy at 33ft (±3mm/10m) in indoor. Perfect for tile alignment, picture hanging, window and door installation, cabinet carpentry, and wallpaper projects.

【Self-leveling & Manual Mode】Switch easily between self-leveling and manual modes using the slide switch. In self-leveling mode, the laser auto-levels within ±4°, and flashes if tilted beyond. Note: To ensure proper self-leveling, the device must be placed on a flat and stable surface. Lock the pendulum to activate manual mode for angled use. In manual mode, the laser flashes every 5 seconds to remind users of the current operating status.

items.label: ✅ Important Shutdown Note To turn off the laser properly
items.value: 1️⃣ Switch to Manual Mode first 2️⃣ Then press Power Button (Built for safety and stability.)（Not suitable for outdoor use）

items: 【Includes 40" Tripod for Precise Indoor Use】This compact aluminum tripod adjusts from 11.4" to 40", perfect for tabletop or low-angle tasks. The 360° swivel head with 3-way pan lets you tilt and rotate for any angle, whether portrait or landscape. Features a 1/4" quick-release plate for fast laser level mounting—ideal for picture hanging, home projects, or precise alignment in tight spaces.

【Compact & Protected for Indoor Use 】Designed for indoor tasks, this lightweight laser level offers easy handling with a compact build and IP54-rated protection against dust and minor water splashes. Its durable shock-resistant housing withstands 4 ft. drops, making it ideal for home improvement, picture hanging, shelving, or light renovation. Operates safely between -10°C and 50°C in most indoor environments.

【Ready to Use – Includes 2 AA Batteries】This self-leveling laser level comes with 2 AA batteries for up to 6 hours of indoor use. For extended runtime, users can upgrade to 1500mAh+ rechargeable or alkaline batteries (not included). Compact and user-friendly, it’s ideal for picture hanging, shelf mounting, or light DIY tasks. Class II laser (<1mW) ensures safe and accurate performance.

【Worry-Free Guarantee & Full Kit Included】Huepar stands behind its laser levels with a 1-year warranty, extendable to 2 years with product registration (details inside box). Enjoy responsive U.S.-based support for any questions. Package includes: 98ft laser level, aluminum tripod, 2 AA batteries, canvas carry bag, and user manual—everything you need for accurate indoor leveling right out of the box.

【Important Tripod Notice 】The included tripod is compact and portable for indoor use, but its built-in bubble level is decorative only and does not provide precise horizontal alignment. For accurate leveling, please rely on the laser tool itself. We recommend reviewing the tripod specs before purchase to ensure it meets your setup needs and avoids any inconvenience during use.
